faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our service and workflow.

items.q1: How does the monthly service work?
items.a1: We work on a monthly subscription basis. Each plan includes a defined quantity of deliverables (video editing, design, posts, etc.). We use our dedicated portal to coordinate the content calendar and approvals.
items.a2: We accept local ACH transfers for US clients (processed through ARQ/DolarApp with $0 processing fee), international credit/debit card payments via Takenos (5% + $0.50 fee), and Argentine peso payments via Mercado Pago to avoid local tax surcharges.
items.q3: How does the approvals portal work?
items.a3: Once our team edits your videos or designs your posts, we upload them to your personal portal. You will receive a notification to log in, review the deliverable, and approve it or request changes with a single click. No content is published without your prior approval.
items.q4: Can I change my plan or cancel at any time?
items.a4: Yes, absolutely. You can request to change plans or cancel your subscription by writing directly to our support before your next monthly billing date. There are no long-term contracts or hidden fees.
items.q5: What happens if I don't use all the deliverables in my plan during the month?
items.a5: Deliverables included in each monthly billing cycle are non-cumulative. This allows us to guarantee the availability of our editors and designers dedicated exclusively to your brand.
items.q6: How long does the first delivery take after onboarding?
items.a6: After the onboarding meeting and receiving your brand assets or brief, we deliver the first batch of optimized content ready for your review within 3 to 5 business days.
